tool_input.description: Find where validation issues are converted to field errors

result:
Tags on posts are in place: authors can enter them, they show on the list and post pages, and `/posts?tag=<name>` filters the list. `pnpm typecheck` passes. I did not boot the app or exercise the routes over HTTP, but I ran the real `postPayloadSchema` against the spec cases (`bun, webdev`, trailing commas, ` bun ,bun`, 5 vs 6 tags, 30 vs 31 characters) and they behave as specified.

The schema gains `tags` and `post_tags` tables, and `void db generate` produced migration `20261018223305_moaning_tana_nile.sql` with its snapshot and journal entry. In `lib/validators.ts`, the `tags` field splits, trims, drops empties, and de-duplicates, then refuses more than 5 names or any name over 30 characters on the `tags` path, the same way the title is refused. `lib/tags.ts` holds the save, attach, and filter helpers. The create and update actions save tags, and the delete action removes `post_tags` rows before the post, since the foreign keys have no cascade. `findPostOrFail` attaches `tags` to each post, so the post page and edit form get them too. The list loader takes `?tag=`, applies it to both the count and the page query, and the pager and search keep the filter.

The Tags input is on the create and edit forms, and the edit form starts with the current tags. The list and post pages render each tag as a link to `/posts?tag=<name>`. The Tags input is a plain text field, and the field is named `tags`, as the spec asks.
